control.description-key: Responsive Gantt view for Dataverse tasks

property-set.name: subject
property-set.description-key: Record title. For Tasks, use Subject.

property-set.name: scheduledend
property-set.description-key: Finish or due date (Date Only or Date and Time). For Tasks, use Due Date.

property-set.name: ownerid
property-set.description-key: Optional owner. The column is hidden when not mapped.

property-set.name: statecode
property-set.description-key: Optional status. The column and status filter are hidden when not mapped.

property-set.name: scheduledstart
property-set.description-key: Start date (Date Only or Date and Time). For Tasks, use Start Date.

property-set.name: createdon
property-set.description-key: Optional. Enables the Created On filter. For Tasks it is also the start fallback.

property-set.name: description
property-set.description-key: Optional description column. Hidden when not mapped.

property-set.name: parent
property-set.description-key: Optional lookup to the parent row in the same table. Enables expandable rows and summary bars.

property-set.name: milestone
property-set.description-key: Optional Yes/No column. Rows set to Yes show a milestone diamond on the Finish date.

property-set.name: sequence
property-set.description-key: Optional number that orders rows under the same parent when no column sort is chosen.

property.name: licenseKey
property.description-key: License key used to activate the control

property.name: dependencyMode
property.description-key: Auto shows dependency lines for Project Operations tasks or a configured link table. Off hides them.

property.name: dependencyTable
property.description-key: Logical name of a custom link table. Links are drawn Finish-to-Start.

property.name: dependencyPredecessorColumn
property.description-key: Logical name of the lookup column on the link table that points to the predecessor row.

property.name: dependencySuccessorColumn
property.description-key: Logical name of the lookup column on the link table that points to the successor row.

property.name: searchColumn
property.description-key: Logical name of a text column. Shows a search box that finds records whose value contains the entered text.

property.name: completedStatusValues
property.description-key: Raw values of the mapped Status column that mean Completed, separated by commas, for example 1 or 192350001. Other values are open. Tasks bound to Status use 1 automatically.

property.name: canceledStatusValues
property.description-key: Raw values of the mapped Status column that mean Canceled, separated by commas. Canceled rows are grey and never overdue. Tasks bound to Status use 2 automatically.

property.name: progressColumn
property.description-key: Logical name of a number column in the view, for example a percent complete column. A row is Completed when its value reaches the Completed progress value. Takes precedence over status values.

property.name: progressCompleteValue
property.description-key: Progress value at which a row is Completed. Default 100.

property.name: dueSoonDays
property.description-key: Open rows turn yellow this many days before Finish. Default 2.

property.name: dueNearDays
property.description-key: Open rows turn orange this many days before Finish. Default 1.

property.name: dueImminentDays
property.description-key: Open rows turn dark orange this many days before Finish. Default 0, the due day. Rows turn red the day after Finish.
